# LayeredAreaChart3D

## Overview

LayeredAreaChart3D is an isometric 3D area chart that renders layered area series as stacked planes in a perspective view. It reuses the same D3 area generators as `AreaChart` (layered mode), with mathematical coordinate projection applied to every point to create a convincing 3D isometric perspective.

This chart supports hover-only interactivity (series highlighting & dimming), configurable depth order, optional grid lines, and axis labels — all rendered directly inside the SVG via isometric projection.

**This component follows the [Organized Props Pattern](./OrganizedPropsPattern.md).**

## Architecture

```
LayeredAreaChart3D
├── ChartAccessibility
│   └── Chart container (CSS module: LayeredAreaChart3D.module.css)
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional)
│       │   ├── ChartTitle
│       │   └── ChartSubtitle
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional, works with any colorType)
│       │   └── ChartKey[] (one per series, colors auto-match palette)
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional, static or hover-driven)
│       ├── SequentialChartKey (optional, sequential colour type)
│       ├── DivergingChartKey (optional, diverging colour type)
│       ├── LayeredAreaGroup3D
│       │   └── SVG (preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet")
│       │       ├── Grid lines (isometric)
│       │       ├── Area paths (painter's algorithm, back → front)
│       │       ├── Axis labels (category, value, series)
│       │       └── Badge (optional, cursor-following hover badge)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional)
│           └── annotation slots (source, notes — inline typography tokens)
```

**Token Resolution**: All colors come from the CSS cascade via Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand. No runtime JS token resolver; no modes prop.

## Import

```tsx
import LayeredAreaChart3D from "./charts/LayeredAreaChart3D";
import type {
  AreaGroup3DConfig,
  SequentialChartKeyConfig,
  DivergingChartKeyConfig,
  DepthOrder,
  ChartSeriesDataPoint,
  ChartLegendItem,
} from "./charts/LayeredAreaChart3D";
```

## Quick Start

```tsx
const data: ChartSeriesDataPoint[] = [
  { category: "Jan", series: "Revenue", value: 100 },
  { category: "Feb", series: "Revenue", value: 120 },
  { category: "Mar", series: "Revenue", value: 115 },
  { category: "Jan", series: "Expenses", value: 80 },
  { category: "Feb", series: "Expenses", value: 85 },
  { category: "Mar", series: "Expenses", value: 90 },
];

<LayeredAreaChart3D
  data={data}
  width={500}
  height={420}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: "Revenue vs Expenses",
    chartSubtitleValue: "Isometric 3D view",
  }}
/>;
```

## Design Tokens

All visual properties are resolved from the CSS cascade via Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand. No runtime JS token resolver; no modes prop.

| CSS Custom Property                      | Usage                                                         | Fallback                    |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| `--Typography-Font-Primary`              | All SVG text labels (axis, series)                            | `'JioType Var', sans-serif` |
| `--Body-FontWeight-Low`                  | All text labels (axis ticks, series names)                    | `400`                       |
| `--Label-S-FontSize`                      | Base font size (converted to viewBox units)                   | `14`                        |
| `--Text-Low`                              | All text label fill (axis ticks, series names)                | Theme-dependent             |
| `--Stroke-M`                              | Grid line stroke width (converted to viewBox units)           | `1`                         |
| `--Stroke-L`                              | Depth/axis line and area path stroke width                    | `1.5`                       |
| `--Spacing-2`                             | Label gap from axis (converted to viewBox units)              | `8`                         |
| `--Shape-1`                               | Container border radius                                       | `4`                         |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1-N}`        | Area fill colors (one per series, matching legend key colors) | Theme-dependent             |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-{1-N}`       | Dimmed area fill colors on hover                              | Theme-dependent             |
| Motion tokens (easing, duration, offsetDelay) | Entry and data-transition animation                           | Theme-dependent             |

Pixel-based token values (font sizes, stroke widths, spacing) are converted to viewBox coordinate units via a `pxToVB` scaling factor derived from the measured container width and the viewBox width (`vbW / effectiveWidth`). The container is measured dynamically via a `ResizeObserver`, so the chart is fully responsive — font sizes and strokes scale correctly at any container size.

### Sizing modes

The component supports two sizing modes depending on the `height` prop:

| Height prop                            | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Not set (default `350`)                | Container uses CSS `aspectRatio` matching the viewBox's natural proportions. Height is auto-derived from width — no letter-boxing.                               |
| Explicit value (`"100%"`, `500`, etc.) | Container uses the given height directly. The SVG scales via `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"` to fill the available space both horizontally and vertically. |

When the parent `LayeredAreaChart3D` passes `height="100%"` inside a `flex: 1` wrapper, the isometric group fills the full available height. When used standalone with no height constraint, the aspect-ratio mode ensures the chart derives its height naturally from width.

The viewBox top bound uses a reduced structural height (`Y_RANGE × 0.7`) instead of the full theoretical maximum. This tightens the vertical fit so the isometric content fills the available space without excessive headroom. Any peaks that extend beyond the viewBox edge still render because the SVG uses `overflow: visible`.

The viewBox also accounts for text elements on each side:

- **Category labels** (series names): the viewBox extends on the label side (right for `isometricAlign="right"`, left for `"left"`) based on the longest series name, preventing label clipping.
- **X-axis labels** (category names such as month abbreviations): the viewBox extends on the opposite side to accommodate half the text width of center-anchored labels.
- **Bottom margin**: when `xAxis` is enabled, additional space is reserved below the structural base for labels that hang beneath the front edge.

## Colour Palettes

The `colorType` prop (in `areaGroup3DConfig`) selects which CSS custom property palette is used for area fills, and which key/legend component renders.

| `colorType`               | CSS Custom Properties used                                      | Key component                       | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `"categorical"` (default) | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1-N}`, `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-{1-N}` | `ChartLegend` (dot items)           | One distinct colour per series (up to 12). Hover uses a separate hover colour from the token system.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `"sequential"`            | `--DataVis-Sequential-Category{set}-{1-steps}`                 | `SequentialChartKey` (gradient bar) | A single-hue ramp distributed evenly across series. Configure with `sequentialColorSet` (1-6) and `sequentialSteps` (1-9). When the number of series exceeds `sequentialSteps`, OKLCH colour-space interpolation generates unique per-series shades between the token anchor colours. Hover dims via `dimOpacity`. |
| `"diverging"`             | `--DataVis-Diverging-Negative-{1-5}`, `--DataVis-Diverging-Neutral`, `--DataVis-Diverging-Positive-{1-5}` | `DivergingChartKey` (gradient bar)  | A two-tone ramp from negative through neutral to positive, distributed across series. Configure with `divergingSteps` (1-5). Hover dims via `dimOpacity`.                                                                                                                                                          |

### Key / Legend rendering rules

- **`chartLegend`** (default `true`) renders the `ChartLegend` dot list for **any** `colorType`. The dot colours automatically match the active palette (categorical, sequential, or diverging).
- **`sequentialChartKey`** (default `false`) independently enables a gradient bar key — `SequentialChartKey` when `colorType="sequential"`, `DivergingChartKey` when `colorType="diverging"`. Has no effect when `colorType="categorical"`.
- Both toggles are independent: you can show just the dot legend, just the gradient key, both, or neither.
- When `sequentialChartKey` is enabled, data min/max values are auto-derived for tick labels. Override them via `sequentialChartKeyConfig.lowestDataValue` / `highestDataValue` or `divergingChartKeyConfig.tickValues`.
- Both `SequentialChartKey` and `DivergingChartKey` receive `width="100%"` from `LayeredAreaChart3D` so they stretch to fill the chart container. Their standalone default width is `"328px"`, which would clip inside a wider container without this explicit override.

Legend key colours are always kept in sync with the area fill colours regardless of palette type.

## Isometric Projection

The chart uses standard isometric projection where the X-axis tilts 30° right, the Z-axis tilts 30° left, and the Y-axis is vertical.

For a 3D point `(x, y, z)` where `x` is the category position, `y` is the data value, and `z` is the series depth index:

```
screen_x = x × cos(30°) + z × depthSpacing × cos(30°)
screen_y = −y + x × sin(30°) − z × depthSpacing × sin(30°)
```

The SVG uses `preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"` to maintain the isometric angle ratio regardless of container size.

## Depth Order

The `depthOrder` prop controls front-to-back ordering of series:

- `"dataOrder"` (default) — First series in the data appears in **front**, last in back.
- `"reverse"` — First series in the data appears in **back**, last in front.

Rendering always follows the painter's algorithm: the backmost series is drawn first so that front series naturally occlude it.

## Depth Spacing

`depthSpacing` (default `1`) controls the Z-axis gap between series planes. Higher values spread series further apart. The viewBox is auto-calculated to fit all projected points.

## Hover & Keyboard Behaviour

When a series is hovered (mouse) or focused (keyboard):

- The active series retains full opacity and its `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-*` color.
- All other series dim to `dimOpacity` (design token, default 0.2) with `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-*` color.
- The `onSeriesHover` callback fires with `{ seriesIndex, name, isHovered }`.
- When `hoverBadge` is `true`, a cursor-following `Badge` appears displaying the series name and formatted value. Configure value formatting via `areaGroup3DConfig.valueFormat`.

### Keyboard Navigation

The chart provides keyboard accessibility via `useRovingTabIndex` over series:

- **Tab** into the chart to focus the first series.
- **Arrow Left / Arrow Right** move focus between series (with wrap-around).
- **Focus** triggers the same highlight + live-region announcement as mouse hover.
- **Tab out** clears the active series.

The live region announces `"{series name}, total {sum}"` with 150ms debounce wired through `useChartAccessibility` (which composes `useAriaLiveRegion` internally) to avoid rapid-fire announcements when arrowing quickly.

### Controlled Hover

Use `hoveredSeriesIndex` for controlled hover state (e.g., external list highlighting).

## Animation

With `animated: true` the chart supports two animation phases:

### Entry Animation

On first mount, areas morph from the baseline (flat) to their actual values using SVG `<animate>` elements. Each series staggers by `offsetDelay` ms. Motion tokens (easing, duration, offset delay) are resolved from the `enterAnimation` collection via `useEntryAnimation`.

### Data Transition

When the `data` prop changes after mount, areas smoothly interpolate from their previous paths to the new ones in place — no stagger delay. The transition uses:

- `d3.interpolateString` to build per-path interpolators between old and new SVG `d` attributes
- A `requestAnimationFrame` loop driven by `duration` and `easing` tokens from the `transitionAnimation` collection (via `useDataTransition`)
- A custom cubic-bezier solver that converts the CSS `cubic-bezier(...)` token into a JS easing function

All timing values are resolved from Figma design tokens — no hardcoded animation values.

## Edge Cases

| Case             | Behaviour                                                            |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Single series    | Renders as a single isometric area (no depth stacking)               |
| Many series (5+) | Adjust `depthSpacing` to control visual spread; viewBox auto-expands |
| Negative values  | Clamped to 0 — negative areas below the floor are not rendered in 3D |
| Empty data       | Renders an empty container                                           |

## Differences from AreaChart

| Feature             | AreaChart                            | LayeredAreaChart3D                 |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| Projection          | Flat 2D                              | Isometric 3D                       |
| Stacking types      | stacked, layered, fullHeight         | Layered only (implicit)            |
| Hover badge         | Yes                                  | Yes (opt-in via `hoverBadge` prop) |
| Keyboard navigation | Yes (roving tab index, per category) | Yes (roving tab index, per series) |
| Y/X Axis components | Standard YAxis / XAxis               | Built-in isometric labels          |
| ViewBox             | `0 0 100 H` (non-uniform)            | Auto-calculated (uniform)          |
| preserveAspectRatio | `"none"`                             | `"xMidYMid meet"`                  |
